verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is GPU compute hardware with management tooling. A built-in AI assistant that users delegate tasks to is not an axis buyers compare for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the system ships one: Mission Control, the BMC web UI, and the health-monitoring CLI are operations and management software, not task-delegation assistants.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
